items.en: Please take me to this address
items.detail: Then show the hotel line below. The single most useful card here.
Squat unless marked 坐便. 有纸吗？ is “is there paper?” and the answer is usually no.
Sealed bottle only, and it is what you brush your teeth with too.

items.en: I don't need it, thank you
items.detail: For touts. Say it once and keep walking; engaging is what they are fishing for.
扫码 is scan-the-QR, which is what Alipay actually does. Foreign cards still fail at plenty of terminals.
Where KE 141 lands. All international flights use T5 and it has its own Line 14 station.

items.cn: 西安威斯汀大酒店，西安市曲江新区慈恩路66号
items.detail: Also the permit delivery address. Show this to the courier and to every taxi.
Opposite the hotel. Fountain show in the north square.
The bike ride. 13.7 km around.

items.en: South Gate — city wall bike rental
items.detail: Open to 22:00. After 20:00 every bike comes back here, evening returns by 21:30.
Line 2. The airport coach terminates near here.
Short walk from the wall's north side. Go after dark.
THE SHOPPING RUN. Without the moulded 3C mark it is confiscated at Lhasa. Point at the mark, not the box.
For the train corridor and the shared showers at base camp.
Buy more than you think. There is no paper at base camp.
药店. For anything you forgot — but bring your own eye drops and prescriptions from home.
33 km east. Passport is the ticket — the gate scanners read it directly.
15 minutes' walk from the Westin. Also the WeChat account name to search.

items.en: Xi'an Railway Station — the one you want
items.detail: No. 44 Huancheng North Road, outside the northeast corner of the wall. Line 4 from Dayanta, no change.

items.en: Xi'an NORTH Station — the WRONG one
items.detail: The high-speed station, and a different part of the city. Showing a driver this instead of 西安站 loses you the Z165.

items.en: Train Z165 to Lhasa, soft sleeper
items.detail: 软卧 is the four-berth cabin. No paper ticket — you board by laying the passport on the gate scanner.
Every carriage has a dispenser. It is how the whole train eats.
Berth numbers are on the ticket record in the app, not on a card.
Arriving on the Z165 in the afternoon of the 3rd.
Checked to board the train and again at road checkpoints. James delivers it to the Westin.
高原反应 is the everyday term and every Tibetan hotel desk knows it.
Hotels and the tour van carry it. Ask early rather than late.
The rentals for the parka and the sleeping bag are around here.
Debating courtyard in the afternoon.
Timed entry and passport-checked. Shoulders covered, hat off.
The holiest site in Tibet. Walk the Barkhor circuit clockwise.
On the road to Shigatse, over the first 5,000 m pass.
Two nights here bracket the base camp run.
珠穆朗玛峰 is the full name. The tent night at 5,200 m.
Shigatse, then back to Lhasa.
MU 2336 out, 15:30. About an hour from the city.
Where you LAND, 21:50. Not where you leave from.

items.cn: 上海南京路步行街锦江都城南京饭店，上海黄浦区山西南路200号
items.detail: Saturday night. Show this to the Didi driver at Hongqiao — the last Line 11 has gone by the time you clear the airport.
100 People's Avenue, east side of People's Square. 09:00 opening is the quiet slot.
Line 10 for the Metro Museum. ONLY 杭中路 trains stop here — a 虹桥机场 train is the wrong branch.
1799-7 Wuzhong Road, Ziteng Road Exit 1. 10:00–16:00, ¥30 on the door.
Lunch and the classical garden. The tea-ceremony approach here is a scam — see 我不需要，谢谢 above.
Walk it north at dusk. Lights come up around 18:00.
Runs from the hotel door to People's Square.

items.en: Toy Story Hotel — Sun to Thu
items.cn: 玩具总动员酒店，上海浦东新区申迪西路360号
items.detail: Four nights from Sunday. The station shuttle runs 06:45–23:00.
Line 11 terminus, Disney Resort station.
Where the early-entry voucher is checked, 07:30–08:30.
DL 38 at 18:25. You arrived at Hongqiao and you leave from Pudong; they are 50 km apart. Leave the hotel by 15:00.
